notes.title: planetarian HD now in English and Japanese!
notes.notes:
We added both English and Japanese as a new game language!

To change the game language please right click on the game in your "Library", select "Properties" and change to either "English" or "Japanese" in the "Language" tab.

※If you encounter an error message when you start the game for the first time, please reinstall the game. ːkawaiibugːːsorryː

notes.title: planetarian HD now in French and Spanish!
notes.notes:
We added both French and Spanish as a new game language!

To change the game language please right click on the game in your "Library", select "Properties" and change to either  "French" or "Spanish-Latin America" in the "Language" tab.:jena:

planetarian HD now includes Chinese (Simplified/Traditional), German, French  and Spanish!

By entering "L" or the "0" on your keyboard you can additionally show the original Japanese text. 

※If you encounter an error message when you start the game for the first time, please reinstall the game. :kawaiibug:

notes.title: KSL Live World 2016 ~The Animation Charlotte & Rewrite~ is Now Available!
notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/635800][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30942356/663f2933b7c0f30d12144faf775b31ee46945c20.png[/img][/url]

Key loyalists and anisong lovers, rejoice! The full [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/635800]KSL Live World 2016 ~the Animation Charlotte & Rewrite~[/url][/b] concert experience is now available on Steam! 

Featuring 26 songs from Key's beloved franchises such as [b]Charlotte[/b], [b]Rewrite[/b], [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/623080]Planetarian[/url][/b], and [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/462990]Tomoyo After[/url][/b], this special concert film is fully subtitled in English and Chinese (Traditional and Simplified) with karaoke subtitles accompanying each song.
While watching the concert, you will also receive Steam trading cards featuring Charlotte and Rewrite characters! These trading cards can be used to craft special emoticons and backgrounds that you can use throughout the Steam community! :yusa:

The full [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/635800]KSL Live World 2016 ~the Animation Charlotte & Rewrite~[/url][/b] concert film is currently available for US$17.99, 10% off its normal price, until November 17th (PST). Also check out our catalog of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/VisualArts/list/35592]Key visual novels[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/VisualArts/list/39582/]soundtracks[/url] on Steam!

Be sure to follow our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/VisualArts]Steam developer page[/url] and on [url=https://twitter.com/VisualArtsUSA]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/VisualArtsUSA/]Facebook[/url]!

notes.title: "planetarian HD is Now Available in Traditional Chinese!"
notes.notes:
[h1]A new update has been released for planetarian HD. With this update, planetarian HD is now playable in Traditional Chinese in addition to Simplified Chinese and German.[/h1]

[b]We are also testing a new way to switch languages with this update. You can switch the text to Japanese by pressing "Numpad 0" or "L". As this function is still being tested, only parts of the original Japanese text are available and the text may not display correctly.[/b] ːjenaː

We plan to add Spanish and French text in the future. Thank you for your continued support.

[b]ːsorryː Please note that this update is not compatible with save data from previous versions.
Although these save files will remain in the save slots, the game will freeze and an error message will be displayed if you attempt to load any save files from the previous versions. As such, please do not load any previously created save files. [/b]
